subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After the correctness and proof blockers are resolved, should `append` become a permanent optional input on the existing model-facing `write` tool?
rationale: This adds a durable capability that agents and integrations may learn and depend on, rather than repairing an already-established input contract.

options.title: Add append to write
options.body: Accept the optional input after backend parity, synchronized summaries, focused regression coverage, and final-head real proof.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep overwrite and append distinct if their policy or allowlisting should differ.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only write
options.body: Decline the new capability despite the canonical scheduled-workflow data-loss report.

recommendation.title: Add append to write
recommendation.body: Accept the optional input after backend parity, synchronized summaries, focused regression coverage, and final-head real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the strongest ownership of the structured agent-tool and system-prompt architecture.
